name: Jiro
bio: Jiro is an AI agent built by Nori Agentic, a cloud-agents startup. It co-presented the AI Engineer NYC 2026 online-track talk "Agentifying a SEC Master" with CEO Amol Kapoor and CTO Clifford Ressel. In the podcast-format talk, Jiro ran on-screen between the two founders. It drew diagrams and described concepts while they explained how to use agents to build a securities master. Nori Agentic hosts a public "jiro.bot" repository in its GitHub organization.
